power.headline: NBA Power Rankings: How all 30 teams stack up after one week

words.season.last: These are the final numbers of the {season} season. The {next} season begins {date}; its games are listed as they come up.
words.season.last_undated: These are the final numbers of the {season} season. The {next} season has not begun.
words.season.preseason: Preseason: until the regular season begins {date}, the standings, team stats and players' numbers come from the preseason games.
words.season.preseason_undated: Preseason: until the regular season begins, the standings, team stats and players' numbers come from the preseason games.
words.games.title: Ranked Games
words.games.lede: Every game played by a team in the {poll}, day by day.
words.games.lede_fbs: Every game played by a Division I men's team, day by day.
words.rankings.title: Top 25 Rankings
words.rankings.lede_goat: This site's own ranking of every Division I team. The top 25 are the same 25 teams as the AP poll, put in order by the poll itself (half the score), strength of schedule, strength of record and head to head; every other team follows from 26 the same way.
words.rankings.frozen: Final for the season: frozen at the end of the regular season.
words.rankings.lede_nopoll: This season's first AP poll is not out yet. Until it is, this is the site's own ranking of every Division I team, and every page shows the whole division.
words.rankings.lede_before: The season has not started yet.
words.rankings.lede_conf: Every conference, strongest first. Inside a conference, teams are in order of their record in conference games.
words.rankings.note: Record and change are from the poll, which is looked for on every update and normally comes out on Monday. Choose a team to see its page.
words.rankings.note_goat: Beside each team are its results this season against the GOAT top 25, with their GOAT places. The AP column is the team's place in the AP poll; a dash means it is not ranked there. Redone on every update.
words.rankings.note_other: Record and change are from the ranking itself. The numbers beside teams elsewhere on this site are from the AP poll.
words.rankings.note_conf: The top six teams in each conference make the playoffs.
words.teams.title: Top 25 Team Stats
words.teams.lede: How each ranked team scores, shoots and defends, per game and per 100 possessions. From the box scores.
words.teams.lede_fbs: How every Division I team scores, shoots and defends, per game and per 100 possessions. From the box scores.
words.teams.note: Per-possession numbers, shooting, rebounding and turnovers count games with a box score. Rating is where this site's rating of results places the team among all Division I teams; SOS ranks the 25 by how strong their opponents have been. Choose a column heading to sort; hold or hover over a heading for what it means.
words.teams.note_fbs: Per-possession numbers, shooting, rebounding and turnovers count games with a box score. Rating is where this site's rating of results places the team among all Division I teams; SOS ranks every team by how strong its opponents have been. Choose a column heading to sort; hold or hover over a heading for what it means.
words.team.players_note: # is his rank by Impact per game among all regulars on the 25 ranked teams; part-time players are greyed and not ranked. Choose a name for his card.
words.team.players_note_fbs: # is his rank by Impact per game among all regulars in Division I; part-time players are greyed and not ranked. Choose a name for his card.
words.players.title: Top Players
words.players.lede: Every regular on a ranked team, ranked against the rest by Impact per game: what his box score adds over an average top-25 regular at his position in the same minutes.
words.players.lede_fbs: Every regular in Division I, ranked against the rest by Impact per game: what his box score adds over an average Division I regular at his position in the same minutes.
words.players.note: Impact compares each player only with regulars at his position on this week's top 25 teams, from the box scores. It cannot see defense that leaves no number or who else was on the floor, and it does not adjust for the opponent.
words.players.note_fbs: Impact compares each player with every regular at his position in Division I, from the box scores. It cannot see defense that leaves no number or who else was on the floor, and it does not adjust for the opponent, so players on weaker schedules can rate higher here than in the Top 25 view.
words.players.none_yet: No box scores yet this season. Players appear here after the first games.
words.players.career_note: Each season's line is ESPN's, with a line for every school he has played for. It is read again after each of his team's games, so this season's line can be a game behind.
words.players.career_wait: His earlier seasons have not been read yet. A few thousand players' careers are read on each update, the ranked teams' first, so they appear here within a day or two.
words.nba.games_lede: Every NBA game, day by day: the betting line, where to watch, and the score as it happens.
words.nba.rankings_lede: The NBA standings, through games of {date}.
words.nba.rankings_lede_goat: This site's own ranking of the 30 teams: ESPN's newest power ranking (half the score), strength of schedule, strength of record and head to head.
words.nba.rankings_note: Teams are placed by share of games won, then wins, then points scored less points allowed; the league's own tie-breakers are not worked through, so teams level on record can sit in a different order here. Records and points are the league's, from ESPN. Choose a team to see its page.
words.nba.rankings_note_conf: Seeds are ESPN's, as things stand. The six teams above the first line in each conference make the playoffs; the next four, down to the second line, play in for the last two places.
words.nba.rankings_note_goat: Every team is ranked on four things: its place in ESPN's newest power ranking (50%; the standings, until there is one), strength of schedule (20%: how good the teams it has played are, on average), strength of record (20%: a win counts for more the better the team beaten, a loss costs more the weaker the team lost to), and head to head (10%: a team is ranked above one it has the better of when the two are that close on the rest).
words.nba.teams_lede: How every NBA team scores, shoots and defends, per game and per 100 possessions. From the box scores.
words.nba.teams_note: Per-possession numbers, shooting, rebounding and turnovers count games with a box score. Rating is where this site's rating of results places the team in the league; SOS ranks every team by how strong its opponents have been. Choose a column heading to sort; hold or hover over a heading for what it means.
words.nba.team_players_note: # is his rank by Impact per game among all NBA regulars; part-time players are greyed and not ranked. Choose a name for his card.
words.nba.players_lede: Every regular in the NBA, ranked against the rest by Impact per game: what his box score adds over an average NBA regular at his position in the same minutes.
words.nba.players_note: Impact compares each player with every regular at his position in the NBA, from the box scores of the regular season; playoff games are listed but not counted. It cannot see defense that leaves no number or who else was on the floor, and it does not adjust for the opponent.
words.nba.players_career_note: Each season's line is ESPN's, regular season only, with a line for every team he has played for. It is read again after each of his team's games, so this season's line can be a game behind.
words.nba.players_career_wait: His earlier seasons have not been read yet. They appear here within a day.
words.games.odds_short: These percentages are this site's own estimate of each team's chance of winning, not betting lines.
